messages:
Ana (Growth): Hey design — need a small asset set for next week's Redwood benchmark launch. main asks: hero benchmark chart for blog, social-ready variants, a simple 1-slide diagram explaining Hosted / Dedicated / Private, and a webinar slide template. due by EOD Wed if possible.
Mike (Design Ops): Noted. Prioritize hero social + webinar slide. Can you attach the benchmark CSV and any callouts?
Ana (Growth): attaching the CSV in a sec. Key callouts: 'up to 3x lower latency' and '40% lower cost per token' — but keep language defensible, e.g., "Redwood-verified performance vs popular open endpoints". also need alt text for accessibility.
Jessica (Product Marketing): For copy: short headline options: 1) "Faster inference, lower cost — Redwood Inference benchmarks" 2) "Run LLMs with predictable latency and better cost" Include subhead: "Verified across common workloads: chat, completion, embeddings." Prefer option 1 for hero.
Oliver (Benchmarks): CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/rlm-jun25.csv — it has qps, p95 latency, tokens/m, and cost/token estimates for each model/endpoint. Use p95 and cost/token columns.
Eva (Designer): Thanks. A few Qs: 1) exact hex for brand primary? 2) Do we want competitor labels on the chart or anonymized bars (A/B/C)? 3) Webinar slide: portrait or widescreen?
brandbot: Brand guidelines: use #0A2540 (primary), #00C2A8 (accent), Inter Variable 400/700. Logos available here: https://assets.redwood/company-logos.zip — follow logo spacing rules.
Ana (Growth): Hex looks right. Competitor labels: anonymize (Competitor A/B) for legal simplicity. Webinar slide: widescreen 16:9. Include speaker headshots and a slide for tl:dr benchmark summary.
Mike (Design Ops): Deliverables checklist -> hero blog chart (1200x628), social square (1080x1080), twitter card (1200x675), linkedin banner (1104x736), 1x 16:9 slide master (.pptx + fig), 1-slide diagram svg (min 1200px width). Provide source fig + exported PNGs.
Eva (Designer): Got it. Will mock up 2 visual directions by tomorrow noon: 1) clean bars + gradient accent, 2) infographic-style with icons for hosted/dedicated/private. Which to prioritize?
Jessica (Product Marketing): prioritize option 1 for hero/chart, but deliver both if timeline allows for the slide. Also include short CTA: "See the benchmark" and a small sublink: /benchmarks.
Oliver (Benchmarks): Small data note: p95 measured at 256 token windows — add an asterisk and footnote: "p95 measured on 256-token requests; see methodology link." Methodology: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/method.md
Eva (Designer): Cool. I'll include the footnote and a small methodology badge. Timeline: mockups by tomorrow noon, final assets by Wed EOD. Any objections?
Ana (Growth): Sounds good. Also ensure image alt text — I'll write alt copy after visuals are done.
Mike (Design Ops): One more: avoid using direct competitor logos or trademarked product names in imagery. Keep copy comparative but non-branded.
Jessica (Product Marketing): I'll draft two short social captions to go with assets. Drop them here when designs are ready.
Eva (Designer): Working on it — will ping when the Figma link is up.
Ana (Growth): Thanks team :rocket:
Mike (Design Ops): Figma link (soon): https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/benchmark-launch — I'll post when mockups are ready for review.
Eva (Designer): first mock uploads at 1768901350 — requesting quick review cycle (30–45 min)
Ana (Growth): Will review ASAP.
Jessica (Product Marketing): Ping me for copy tweaks during review.
Oliver (Benchmarks): If designers want raw svg of chart lines/bars, I can export clean CSV -> svg. LMK.
Eva (Designer): Please do, Oliver — svg data helps keep shapes sharp.
brandbot: Compliance check scheduled: low-risk. Please ensure alt text and methodology link are present on blog post.
Ana (Growth): Great — thanks everyone. We'll iterate in the figma review thread.
